vt-pdrn-reedle-shot-brush-hair-serum.name: VT - PDRN Reedle Shot Brush Hair Serum
vt-pdrn-reedle-shot-brush-hair-serum.short_description: Give your hair care routine a serious upgrade! VT Cosmetics' PDRN Reedle Shot Brush Hair Serum is a multitasking scalp solution that tackles everything from a tired scalp to dandruff to excess oil. It nourishes and revitalizes the scalp with PHYTO PDRN and caffeine. It also contains VT’s signature CICA REEDLE that promotes absorption of active ingredients. Amino acids boost hair shine while improving scalp health. Use its brush head to massage hair serum onto your scalp for maximum benefits.
vt-pdrn-reedle-shot-brush-hair-serum.description:
Benefits:

  • Instant cool-down: Packed with menthol and centella asiatica, this VT Cosmetics hair serum delivers an immediate cooling sensation on contact, instantly calming hot, bothered scalps.
  • Boosts fullness and vitality: Powered by caffeine and wild ginseng-derived PHYTO PDRN™ to nourish the scalp and support thicker, fuller-looking hair right from the roots.
  • Deep-delivering micro-spicules: Contains CICA REEDLE™ technology which helps active nutrients absorb deeper while gently removing buildup.
  • Silky smooth shine: Infused with silk amino acids to tame stubborn frizz, seal in moisture and leave hair with a glossy, non-greasy finish.
  • Convenient built-in massager: Features a 38-bristle brush applicator that dispenses serum straight to the roots while delivering a soothing mini-massage. Fast-absorbing, lightweight and zero rinsing needed!

Recommended for:

  • Flat, thinning hair or excessive shedding
  • Dry, flaky, or easily irritated scalps
  • Anyone wanting a non-greasy leave-in scalp treatment 

How to Use:

  • Use the VT Cosmetics hair serum on either towel-dried or completely dry hair.
  • Twist the brush head to “ON” and squeeze out a small amount of serum onto your scalp.
  • Gently brush from your hairline back toward the crown, massaging lightly as you go to help your scalp soak up all that goodness.

Made in Korea
